definitions.gloss: metropolis, big city, large urban area
definitions.explanation: A very large city with a high population and extensive urban development. Examples include Tokyo, New York, London, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧な{大都会|だいとかい}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{大都会|だいとかい}⟦での→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: Life in a big city is busy.

examples.japanese: {大都会|だいとかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved from the big city to the countryside.

notes:
{大都会|だいとかい} means a large metropolis — not just any city, but a major metropolitan area with millions of people and extensive infrastructure.

FORMS:
大 (great, big) + ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧ (city, urban area).

USAGE:
Typically refers to cities like ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧, ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧, ⟦{名古屋|なごや}→名古屋：19405_nagoya⟧, ⟦ニューヨーク→ニューヨーク：noentry⟧, ⟦ロンドン→ロンドン：noentry⟧, etc. Carries a sense of excitement, opportunity, and sometimes overwhelm.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧: city, urban area (general)
- ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧: city (more formal/administrative)
- ⟦{大都市|だいとし}→大都市：12204_daitoshi⟧: large city (more formal equivalent of {大都会|だいとかい})
- ⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧: capital city
- {大都会|だいとかい}: big city (subjective, experiential)
- ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧: countryside, rural area
- ⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧: suburbs
